description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveSubjects command in the policies querying system of the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests object immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and proper exception handling.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveSubjects command, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveSubjects class is immutable and its key fields are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveSubjects instance with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Checks that passing a null label to create a RetrieveSubjects instance results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a RetrieveSubjects instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.
